title: Technical issues impact half of NASA's Mars fleet
excerpt: NASA faces technical challenges with its Mars fleet, as Perseverance struggles to transmit data and Odyssey runs low on fuel.
body_html:
A significant portion of NASA's active Mars fleet is currently facing serious technical hurdles, leaving half of the aging spacecraft offline or compromised. Among the affected missions are the Perseverance rover and the Odyssey orbiter.

According to recent reports, the Perseverance rover is encountering difficulties when attempting to transmit data back to Earth. Meanwhile, the Odyssey orbiter is rapidly depleting its remaining fuel supply as it continues operations in Martian orbit.

These ongoing challenges highlight the growing operational strains on NASA's robotic explorers as they age in the harsh Martian environment.
